assembly.title: Assembly service
assembly.text: Acme Home assembles furniture in your home for $49 per item. Book it within five days of delivery by asking support; a two-person team comes with its own tools and takes the packaging away. Assembly covers tables, beds, shelving and wardrobes, not rugs or lighting.

oak-care.title: Caring for oak furniture
oak-care.text: Dust oak with a dry cloth and wipe spills at once. Keep it out of direct sunlight and away from radiators, which dry the wood and open cracks. Once a year, rub in a thin coat of Acme Oak Oil along the grain and buff it off after ten minutes.

linen.title: Washing linen covers
linen.text: Wash linen cushion covers inside out at 40 °C on a gentle cycle, with the zip closed. Do not tumble dry: hang them to dry and iron them while still damp. Linen softens with every wash; a little shrinkage, up to 3%, is normal after the first.
